card.name: Surnames in family and biography lists
card.fires_on: Last or middle pieces of a person's surname, such as worth, Dod, Pierce, Tro or Patrick, in biographical text about relatives and children. The name follows a first name.

modes.label: Surname ending
modes.description: The closing piece of a split family name after a first name and often a middle initial.
